content_of_post_to_comment: Something difficult happens, and even after it’s over, we can keep replaying it in our heads. We can’t always change what happened, but we can choose whether to keep carrying the anger, frustration or pain from it. Learning to separate the event from our response can make difficult situations easier to deal with.
comment: Sometimes letting go gets confused with pretending something didn't hurt or that the other person was right. You can accept that something happened and stop replaying it without excusing it or giving up your right to set boundaries. The hard part is learning from what happened without mentally putting yourself through it over and over.
